title: Non-monotonic population scaling and re-entrant photon number dynamics in the dissipative-pumped Tavis--Cummings model
summary: This paper investigates nonlinear dynamics in the dissipative-pumped Tavis--Cummings model (TCM). Under global excitation constraints, the competition between photon decay and pumping leads to two significant effects. First, the steady-state peak population exhibits a non-monotonic plateau: contrary to the expected monotonic decay trend at high energy levels, intermediate energy levels show comparable peak populations, and this plateau gradually shifts to higher energies and broadens as the number of atoms increases.
